segments.name: Florida
segments.description: Makes and sells cement and concrete products in Florida.
segments.evidence: Due to the regional nature of our business, we report our operating results in two reportable segments: Florida

revenueModel.text: Construction contractors and builders buy its cement and concrete.
revenueModel.evidence: We operate and maintain two cement plants, three multi-product marine import terminals, seven active mine locations, 82 ready-mix locations with 96 batch plants, eight concrete block locations with 13 production lines, seven fly ash plants and 22 distribution hubs that can handle various combinations of our products.
